children.value: > Fact From Story: Sam Bankman-Fried, the founder of failed cryptocurrency exchange FTX, is on trial for seven counts of wire fraud and conspiracy.
> > Fact From Story: FTX was a fraud “from the start,” the Securities and Exchange Commission alleges — with a “multi-billion-dollar deficiency caused by his own misappropriation of customer funds.”
> > > Fact From Story: Before FTX, Bankman-Fried co-founded crypto-trading firm Alameda Research in 2017.
> > > Fact From Story: The 31-year-old co-founded FTX in 2019; within a few years the once third-largest crypto exchange’s valuation hit $32 billion at its peak.
> > > Commonsense Knowledge: A CEO is responsible for the actions of their company.
> > Commonsense Knowledge: People who commit fraud are often prosecuted.
> Commonsense Knowledge: Fraud and conspiracy are illegal activities.
